title: Genesis 1:1: first and last letters of all seven words total 1393 = 7 x 199
summary: Genesis 1:1 in colour-coded Hebrew with the number value of the first and last letter of each of the seven words written underneath. Added together (90 + 5 + 400 + 6 + 40 + 5 + 400 + 1 + 40 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 400 + 2) they make 1393, which is 7 x 199.
